criteria.requirement: Add dissoc_in(d, keys, factory=dict, *, strict=False, prune=False). Copy only affected mapping branches and delete the leaf, retain untouched references and input data, preserve empty ancestors by default or prune them explicitly. Missing paths return a shallow root copy unless strict=True; empty paths raise ValueError and scalar ancestors raise TypeError. Support one-shot key paths, mapping factories and toolz/curried/tlz exports in the frozen environment. Keep existing dissoc/assoc_in/update_in semantics unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
